MECANMED is a one-stop medical equipment supplier and local service brand for overseas markets. Starting in 2011, we combine X-ray manufacturing capability with integrated multi-category medical equipment supply chain support.

We serve hospitals, clinics, medical schools, healthcare projects, and medical distributors with medical equipment supply, BOQ and equipment list planning, equipment package solutions, layout suggestions, installation, commissioning, training, and after-sales support. Our products and solutions cover operating rooms, imaging, laboratories, hemodialysis, wards, hospital furniture, veterinary care, and medical education, helping customers complete multi-category medical equipment procurement and project implementation more efficiently.
